as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="flowsTitle" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="<b>🔄 Key data flows</b>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="25" width="290" x="60" y="545" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="flow1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=10;" value="<b>1. Dashboard → LED</b>
hub sets state_update=True
next keepalive returns it
board pulls state, switches LED" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="270" x="70" y="575" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="flow2" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=10;" value="<b>2. Motion → Alarm everywhere</b>
PIR IRQ → flag set → loop sees it
board POSTs /report_motion
hub marks every armed house
next keepalive: alarm=true → buzzer" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="270" x="70" y="640" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="flow3" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=10;" value="<b>3. Button → Dashboard</b>
Button IRQ → flag → toggle local LED → push_state to hub" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="270" x="70" y="720" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legendBox" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontSize=11;align=left;verticalAlign=top;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="220" width="290" x="760" y="540" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legendTitle" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="<b>⚡ The IRQ rule</b>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="25" width="290" x="760" y="545" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legendText" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=10;" value="When you press a button or the PIR fires:

1. Hardware → IRQ handler runs.
2. Handler sets ONE variable:
 self._pressed = True
3. Main loop reads & clears the flag.

NEVER do print() / sleep / HTTP
inside an IRQ — the board will crash." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="180" width="270" x="770" y="575" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
🔁 app_sync.py (the main loop)
while True:
check buttons → was_pressed?
check motion → was_triggered?
every 1 sec: keepalive → hub
if alarm: buzzer.on()
if state_update: pull + apply
sleep 50 ms

div.div:
1. Dashboard → LED
hub sets state_update=True
next keepalive returns it
board pulls state, switches LED

div.div:
2. Motion → Alarm everywhere
PIR IRQ → flag set → loop sees it
board POSTs /report_motion
hub marks every armed house
next keepalive: alarm=true → buzzer

Button IRQ → flag → toggle local LED → push_state to hub

div.div:
When you press a button or the PIR fires:
1. Hardware → IRQ handler runs.
2. Handler sets ONE variable:
self._pressed = True
3. Main loop reads & clears the flag.
NEVER do print() / sleep / HTTP
inside an IRQ — the board will crash.
